post.description:
Email a 6-digit code (10 minutes, 5 tries). Same answer at the staff door for any
email. 429 when asked too often; 503 `email_unavailable` when this deployment has no SMTP.

One click, no email: the seeded demo customer, theatre owner (Orbit Cinemas) or staff
    member (both view-only). The demo customer always has an upcoming and a past booking, and
what earlier visitors booked as them is undone.

Bearer session for the v4 app (`sessions.kind = mobile`, 90 days), from a code sent by
`POST /auth/code` (existing accounts only).

The door (B10): valid once; then "already checked in at HH:MM"; wrong show; not a
ticket. Only the business that owns the show can scan it.
Hold for `a` or `b`: the whole selection or nothing, like a real hold.

get.description: The polling fallback for the stream.
The same live stream as a real seat map (`/shows/{id}/stream`), on the sandbox.

post.description:
Check the holds, price the seats server-side, open a gateway order. 409 `hold_missing`
when a hold lapsed; pressing Proceed twice returns the same pending order.

Test-mode payment when no Razorpay keys are configured: confirms through the same path
as a webhook. 409 when real Razorpay is configured.

The Checkout handler's fast path: a valid signature confirms at once (the webhook,
arriving later, finds the order paid and does nothing).
A signed-in account registers a business (pending until staff verify it).
Generate the seats from a template (grid, or stalls + balcony).

post.description: Ask Frontrow staff to add a film that isn't in the catalogue yet.
The layout these knobs would produce — the live preview while setting up a screen.

Film + language + format + screen + days + times + a price per tier → every show in the
range, or none if any of them overlaps another show on the screen.
Hold the caller's whole selection for 10 minutes — all of it or none of it.

get.description:
Server-sent events: `snapshot` (a `SeatState`) at once and after every hold, release,
sale or lapse; `closed` if the show is cancelled. Ends after a few minutes; EventSource
reconnects on its own.
